SalesChannelCommandCenterSummary.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection; the headline tiles over the list, computed at read time for the filters in force
SalesChannelCommandCenterSummary.description: **The headline figures on Sales Channel Command Center.** The pack's KPI cards, split out of the row (decided 29 September, readiness close-out): a count describes the list, not each item in it.

productsDistributed.description: Products Distributed: distinct products assigned to at least one active channel

SalesChannelCommandCenterView.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over catalogue state, assembled at read time from tables that already exist
SalesChannelCommandCenterView.description: **What Sales Channel Command Center displays.** Read from the workshop pack's own display and configuration directory for this screen; each property names the sentence it came from. **Not a row** - the screen is a view over the module's existing state.

channelType.description: Channel Type (pack p.3-4 Channel Types). The type decides which configuration applies (p.6); each type reports under one SalesChannel value (see salesChannel)

venueScope.description: Venue/Scope: the channel's operational scope level and the name of the scoped item (e.g. a venue name, or Global)

products.description: Products: number of products assigned to the channel

status.description: Status: draft, configuration, validation, approved, scheduled, active, suspended, disabled or archived (the pack's suggested lifecycle, p.5)

publicationStatus.description: Publication Status: unpublished, pendingApproval, scheduled or published (decided 29 September, readiness close-out)

integrationStatus.description: Integration Status: notRequired, notConfigured, connected, degraded or offline (decided 29 September, readiness close-out)

owner.description: Owner: the channel's commercial owner (user ID)

salesChannel.description: The shared reporting dimension this channel's sales are attributed to (b2cWeb -> guestWeb, b2cMobileApp -> guestApp, the POS types -> pos, callCentre, b2bPortal -> b2b, ota and marketplace -> ota, api, reseller/partnerPortal/thirdPartyChannel -> partner; a custom channel picks one) (decided 29 September, readiness close-out)

aiInsights.description: Configuration problems AI flags on this channel (pack p.5, e.g. products assigned without a valid price profile for the channel). Advisory only: nothing is changed until a user acts.
